lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy2Os2 (DyOs) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with four atoms per unit cell and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Dy and Os centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each: Dy is surrounded by 8 Dy and 4 Os, while Os has 6 Dy and 6 Os neighbors, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 3.16–3.43 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all four sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Dy and Os 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, as well as edge- and face-sharing among like-centered Dy and Os polyhedra.
